First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it’s a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Beginner to intermediate, no-drop. It’s no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That’s the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the SLCMTB Tuesday Weekly Social Ride group ride

SLCMTB Tuesday Weekly Social Ride is a mountain bike group ride in Park City, UT. It rolls every Tuesday at 5:45 pm.

A weekly beginner-to-intermediate trail ride on Park City’s flow trails. The group regroups at key intersections so nobody is left behind. Afterward, $5 beers and burgers at O’Shucks. The Meetup has about 2,700 members.
